_readme: Karada Shoujo LLM settings. Edit, save, restart the game (or use LLM Check on the main menu). Keys starting with _ are ignored.
_model_help: Leave empty to use the first chat model LM Studio reports at /v1/models, or paste the exact model id from LM Studio.
_max_tokens_help: null (or -1) = uncapped, best for reasoning/CoT models. A number caps replies; if a capped reply comes back empty with finish_reason=length it is retried once uncapped.
_calibrate_help: picked = run the 'can she say no' probe on each girl when she first becomes active (first pick, switch, double date, migration). off = skip.
_jailbreak_help: Jailbreak preset (Sora / Hikari): chance it takes on each reply. On a miss she answers per the company's rules, like having to regenerate.

summarizer._help: Rolling memory summary (from Wednesday: Sora, Rei, Hikari; Yuzu after her upgrade). When the unsummarized chat passes 'trigger' messages, all but the last 'keep_recent' are folded into a short summary by the same model (heuristic digest if that fails).

message_pool._help: Shared message counts for free windows (morning, walk home with Mio, afternoon, night). Each message to any active girl spends 1. The player picks who, or puts the phone down early.

_debug_help: true = show calibration results, model ids, memory paths, the Wednesday/Thursday recap, and the companion affection meter. Only appears in a developer build (the Ren'Py launcher). Players never see this, even if the flag is left on in a packaged game.

girls._help: Per-girl overrides. Any key left empty uses the shared value above. Point one girl at a different model or server to test a 'model swap'.

affection._help: Companion-app (Hikari / Tsunagari) only. Warmth classifier updates the meter after each player message; the new value applies to the next turn.
